results.title: Jr NTR Health Update: Telugu Actor Advised 8 Weeks of Rest After Sustaining Injury To Shoulder
results.description: Telugu cinema star Jr NTR has sustained a shoulder injury and has been advised by medical professionals to undergo six to eight weeks of complete rest. The actor's official management team confirmed the development through a press statement released on July 27, reassuring fans and the public that the condition is stable and there is no cause for panic.

results.title: Suneil Anand Passes Away After Heart Attack at 70
results.description: Suneil Anand, actor and the only son of legendary Bollywood icon Dev Anand, has passed away at the age of 70 after suffering a heart attack in London on July 26.

results.title: Watch: As Assam battles worst floods in 60 years, MLAs pledge salaries
results.description: As Assam recovers from its worst floods in 60 years, all MLAs except those from the Raijor Dal have pledged one month's salary towards flood relief. The floods have affected over 7.5 lakh people and claimed at least 68 lives, with relief and rehabilitation efforts continuing across the State.
